enabled.description: Indicates whether to retry sending batches in case of export failure.

initial_interval.description: The time to wait after the first failure before retrying; ignored if enabled is false.

max_elapsed_time.description: The maximum amount of time (including retries) spent trying to send a request/batch; ignored if enabled is false. Once this value is reached, the data is discarded. If set to 0, the retries are never stopped.

max_interval.description: The upper bound on backoff interval; ignored if enabled is false. Once this value is reached the delay between consecutive retries will always be `MaxInterval`.

multiplier.description: The factor by which the backoff interval bounds are multiplied on each attempt; ignored if enabled is false.

randomization_factor.description: A random factor between 0 and 1 used to calculate next backoffs (randomized interval = RetryInterval * (1 ± RandomizationFactor)); ignored if enabled is false.

back_off_config.description: Defines configuration for retrying batches in case of export failure. The current supported strategy is exponential backoff.
